name: RC-B10-0143/2026 – After § 15 – Am 14
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text: 15b. Denounces the double standards of certain Member States that, while calling for tougher sanctions against the Russian Federation in support of Ukraine, continue to import significant quantities of LNG from Russia, thereby indirectly contributing to the financing of the Russian budget and the war effort, notably France, which remains a significant player in the Russian gas market in Europe and which saw its imports of Russian LNG jump by around 80 % between 2023 and 2024, making France one of the largest European importers of Russian LNG;
